zh: 伊迪斯科文大学，简称ECU，1902年始创于西澳首府伯斯，校名以澳洲联邦议会中第一位女议员 - 伊迪斯·科文而命之；1991年奉-{准升}-格为综合大学. 2004年，ECU排名澳洲第28 ，现为西澳规模第二大的「教学型大学」 ；2009年，ECU商法学院所辖伯斯商学研究所，在西班牙世界大学网路排名的商学院排名全国第9 ；现为的成员大学.
最先设址在珀斯南区的，为西澳大利亚第一所高等教育学园；1982年市内所有的高等教育学院合并为西澳高等教育学院（Western Australian College of Advanced Education）. 1991年1月1日，-{升}-格为伊迪斯科文大学. 今校总区位于君达乐市，与西澳警察学院、西岸专科学校（TAFE）的校园连成一座大学城而闻名.
ECU学生人数今排名西澳第3大，学生总数约23,740名，研究生人数有5,305；包含4,700名来自逾90个国家的国际学生，培育了约30%的西澳大学生.
ECU年年与海外各国大学合办各种学生及职员交换计划、共同研究活动、校际及个人的学术交流；2006年，与IBM协议合作资讯管理教育学程、使用IBM电脑设备，迄今为西澳校区最多的大学，同时乃唯一在西澳颁授学子飞行（Aviation）学位，以备毕业生进入航空界的高等学府.

由于提供飞行教育，故亦专精于观光及餐饮（Tourism & Hospitality）服务行销学. 而教育学由于ECU的历史发展，素为ECU最重要的学系之一. 目前ECU的校园有4座；3处位在伯斯都会区，1处位于伯斯西南180公里的班伯利市： * 君达乐校总区（Joondalup Campus）有商法科系、服务科系（观光及餐饮）、护理科系（医疗、护理及助产）、教育科系、飞行学、都市计划学等. 校内的图书馆、卫生大楼、运动中心、学生活动中心、学习资源中心 、夏日露天电影院、学生住宅区等新颖设施，水准堪称区域首善 ；位于伯斯以北25公里处，素与市内的企业及政府单位有密切的合作关系. * 曼罗利校区（Mt. Lawley Campus）的包括商学、管理学、艺术类；距离伯斯的中央商业区（CBD）仅10分钟车程. 校内运动、电脑、表演艺术等教育资源完善，并有学生住校服务，著名的西澳表演艺术学院与伯斯商学研究所 均在其中. * 教堂地校区（Churchlands Campus）位于中央商业区的5公里处，为ECU最初的校总区；2003年ECU的行政部门及商法学院首先迁往设于君达乐市的新校园，2008年中旬完成所有的迁校事宜，现址为新宿舍. * 班伯利校区（Bunbury Campus）有公共卫生管理学，与当地的医疗服务业有密切合作关系；位于伯斯以南、2小时车程的西澳第二大城；现为西澳地区，校园占地第二广大的大学分校. * 克莱蒙校址已由西澳大学取得使用.
en: Edith Cowan University (ECU) is a public research university in Western Australia. It is named in honour of Edith Cowan, the first woman to be elected to an Australian parliament. It is the second-largest university in the state with over 30,000 students in 2023. Gaining university status in 1991, it was formed from an amalgamation of tertiary colleges with a history dating back to 1902 when the Claremont Teachers College was established.

It offers study programs in healthcare, biomedicine, computer science, education, engineering, psychology, sports science, law, business, humanities, social sciences, aeronautics and the performing arts. It also offers a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) research program and various majors of study in commerce, the arts and sciences. The university has a partnership with the University of Portsmouth in the United Kingdom, with which it offers dual-enrolled programs with integrated overseas study, and the University of Tasmania for naval engineering. ECU also has a notable cybersecurity research program being one of two universities operating federal Academic Centres of Cyber Security Excellence (ACCSE) and the only Australian member university in the InterNational Cyber Security Center of Excellence (INCS-CoE).

It has two metropolitan campuses in Perth (Joondalup and Mount Lawley) and a regional campus in Bunbury. The main Joondalup campus forms the flagship institution of the Joondalup Learning Precinct and features a pine park and pond in the university quadrangle. The Mount Lawley campus, which is home to its Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts among other schools, is The Bunbury campus is located in bushland adjacent to the St John of God Bunbury Hospital which is home to a diverse range of native wildlife including cockatoos, possums, quolls, kangaroos and wallabies.

The university has produced some of Australia's most prominent figures in the performing arts, operates a large nursing school, has a long history of teacher education and has a significant presence in cybersecurity research.

In 1847, the General Board of Education was established to oversee school development in the Swan River Colony. After becoming the Central Board of Education, it was superseded by the then-called Education Department in 1893, which classified schools, graded teachers, defined teachers' positions, implemented a salary scale for teachers, abolished school fees, provided for co-educational schools and made attendance compulsory for children between the ages of six and 14. At this time, the Education Department had "external study" for student teachers, where they taught in the classroom while studying for examinations set by the Department.
